proposed_widenings.name: ignore_hindering_surface
proposed_widenings.justification: The cloak's remaining omitted rider is a web-specific immunity/bypass. Existing condition, speed, and spell-access atoms do not express immunity to a named hindering surface or movement through that surface under altered movement-cost rules.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You can't be caught in webs of any sort and can move through webs as if they were Difficult Terrain."

notes: Authored as a composite magic item. Poison Resistance, Climb Speed equal to walk Speed, and the fixed-DC doubled-area Web cast all fit. Spider Walk is omitted and recorded as the widening. The once-per-dawn recharge was encoded as refill 1d1 on a max-1 use pool because the tracer path does not tolerate omitted dawn regain fields from Dhall.
